subject: Discovery recap & POC handshake — Borealis AI alignment
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@borealis.ai>, Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@borealis.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & POC handshake — Borealis AI alignment

Hi Elena / Marcus,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned heading into a pilot: the aim is to validate Redwood as a production inference layer for Borealis’ customer support summarization pipeline.

Key pain points you shared:
- Inconsistent latency during peak hours (spikes to ~600ms p95 on current infra).
- High per-request cost due to lack of batching and no KV cache reuse.
- Concerns about data residency and auditability for PII-annotated transcripts.

Top goals for the POC:
1) Demonstrate consistent inference latency at p95 <= 150ms for 512-token average requests under a 50 rps sustained profile.
2) Show 30–40% reduction in tokens/second cost via batching + prefix caching and a light quantization profile.
3) Validate traceability: request-level audit logs, retention controls, and KMS-backed keys.

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (prep): access & SSO, sample datasets, security questionnaire answer exchange.
- Week 1: integration & baseline runs (hosted sandbox).
- Week 2: performance tuning (batching, KV caching, model variant test).
- Week 3: acceptance runs + quality checks on a held-out prompt set and basic evals.

Owners & asks:
- Redwood: Priyom (sales/technical lead) and Ben (solutions) will own delivery and infra config.
- Borealis: Elena to own security/access, Marcus to own evaluation criteria.

Immediate asks for kickoff prep:
- A small sample of de-identified transcripts (S3 link or secure share).
- IP allowlist for test environment & contact for SSO/Okta provisioning.
- Preferred kickoff week windows (we suggested Apr 11–15).

Attachments: draft MOP (borealis_poc_mop.pdf) and Redwood security pack stub (redwood_security_pack_v2.pdf). I attached a simple SOW template we can iterate on.

If this aligns, I’ll circulate a one-page MOP and a calendar invite for the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward,

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Elena Martinez <elena@borealis.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@borealis.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.procure@borealis.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & POC handshake — Borealis AI alignment

Thanks Priyom — this is a helpful summary. A few clarifications and comments from our side:

1) Security & compliance: SOC2 evidence would be useful early. Can you point me to the latest report or a redacted summary? Alicia (procurement) will need that to start an internal review.

2) Data handling: we need confirmation on retention windows and whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) for encryption at rest.

3) Performance SLAs: the p95 target looks reasonable; can Redwood commit to a performance baseline on hosted sandbox vs a Dedicated pool? We expect to run a portion of traffic through Dedicated if numbers look good.

4) Procurement timing: Alicia flagged that any contract/PO needs to be in place by May 7 to meet our Q2 vendor onboarding slate.

Kickoff availability: Apr 12 (afternoon PT) or Apr 13 (morning PT) works best for our core team.

Also attaching the internal security contact card for our Infosec lead (infosec@borealis.ai) who will join the kickoff briefly.

Best,
Elena
Elena Martinez
Head of ML Ops, Borealis AI
elena@borealis.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@borealis.ai>, Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@borealis.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.procure@borealis.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & POC handshake — Borealis AI alignment

Elena — appreciate the quick review. Short answers inline and a few specifics so procurement can approximate cost.

- SOC2: latest redacted SOC2 Type II summary is available in the security pack I attached (redwood_security_pack_v2.pdf). If Alicia needs a boxed SOC artifact under an NDA, we can provide it via our security portal.

- Customer-managed keys: supported. We can integrate with your KMS (AWS KMS customer keys) or use our HSM-backed key manager; we’ll document the setup steps in the MOP.

- Performance baseline: for the POC we recommend starting on Redwood Hosted sandbox for rapid iteration. We can reproduce baseline performance and then move the validated config to a Redwood Dedicated pool if you want predictable SLOs. For planning, assume Dedicated will reduce variance but has a lead time for capacity reservation (we can discuss burst options).

Concrete acceptance metrics we propose to bake into the MOP:
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms at sustained 50 rps with 512-token average.
- Throughput: sustained 50 rps with <5% error rate.
- Cost target: 30% lower cost-per-session vs your current endpoint (ballpark; we'll refine after initial runs).
- Quality: pass rate on your prompt suite >= 92% (we’ll run the first eval pass together).

Kickoff: Apr 12 at 1:30 PM PT is fine from our side — I’ll send a calendar invite to lock it.

Next operational asks (before kickoff):
- SSO contact + test Okta SAML metadata or service account for sandbox.
- Small de-identified sample (1–2k transcripts) or a representative batch we can use for tuning.
- A brief prompt suite (CSV) for the quality eval (we can provide a template).

Attachments: I re-attached the same docs and added the SOW template (sow-template.docx) in case Alicia wants to start edits.

Thanks — will send the invite and MOP one-pager by Monday.

— Priyom

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & POC handshake — Borealis AI alignment

Internal note — action items I’ll pick up ahead of the kickoff: 
- Confirm Dedicated pool lead time & ballpark monthly cost for 50 rps profile; can propose a 2-week evaluation burst vs full month reserved.
- Prepare a short runbook for SSO/KMS onboarding (Monica, can you draft the KMS checklist?)
- Create a short A/B guide for quantization profiles we can test quickly to hit the 30% cost target without degrading quality.
- I’ll attend the kickoff and lead infra tuning; Priyom will lead acceptance/quality items.

Also recommend we propose a canary routing plan in the MOP: 5% traffic for first week, 25% week two, ramp to 100% on acceptance.

Ben

ben_carter@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — that plan works. Confirming kickoff: Apr 12, 2027 at 1:30 PM PT. Attendees from our side: Elena, Marcus (ops), our Infosec rep (via calendar), and Alicia for procurement.

We will:
- Share a de-identified sample dataset (S3 link) by end of day Apr 8.
- Start internal procurement review; Alicia will follow up on contract language after your SOW draft.
- Provide Okta test metadata to your SSO contact (Monica) by Apr 9.

Looking forward to the kickoff and the MOP one-pager.

Best,
Elena
